submission.natural_language_explanation: N769+ fires on a lexical token that fills the slot opened by a familiar, tightly-bound local frame: the expected continuation of the immediately preceding word(s) or of the word it sits inside (' time' after 'a'/'a long'/'Once upon a', ' course' after 'Of', ' while' after 'after a', ' things' after 'other', ' case' after 'report a', ' 1' after 'Table', 'html' after '.', 'clock' after "o'", 'ек' after 'л', 'ont' inside 'Brontë'). The same word does not fire it when its local frame does not license it ('time' after 'the' but not after 'a', 'clock' in 'the clock', '.htm' instead of '.html', 'cloud' in 'a purple cloud'), and determiners, function words, spaces and line breaks never fire it.

rival_explanations: It is a general 'filled lexical slot' detector rather than a familiarity detector: it fires on whatever content word completes a determiner-headed noun phrase, verb object or number/label slot, so a rare or odd filler ('cloud' after 'a purple', 'lamp' after 'the') should fire just as strongly as 'time' or 'door'.

It is a phrase-final / pre-boundary position detector that prepares an upcoming function word or punctuation mark: it fires on the last token of a constituent whatever that token is, so 'time' before '.' and 'time' before 'yesterday' should fire equally and the identity of the preceding collocation should not matter.

Panel 2: A caricature of a citizen, with a frown, standing on the same street looking at the politician.

Citizen: "But sir, you've made a lot of promises before, and nothing has changed!"

Fortunately, there are a few DIY solutions you can try to resolve your slow drain issue rather quickly. Here are three for you to try.
If the baking soda method doesn’t clear out your drain, it may be because a significant amount of hair and/or other debris has collected there and you need to remove it. Purchase a Zip-It tool at any home improvement or hardware store and insert it into your drain. It will catch any collected hair or debris that’s blocking the flow of water. Pull it out. If it’s got a big clump of hair, etc. on the end, you’ve probably got your culprit.
If these methods don’t work, there is your standard drain cleaner that you can also buy in a hardware store or even your local grocery store. It’s better if you can use a household solution, but these drain cleaners often work in a pinch. They’re very simple to use. You generally just dump them in your drain and wait. If even this method is not effective, it may be time to call the plumber.
If your drain isn’t responding to common methods of speeding it up, you may have a more serious plumbing problem. If you are in the Oneida area, Mr. Rooter Plumbing can help. adversarial_test_results.prompt: The time had come for the council to publish its findings, but the chair asked for a delay.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests the hypothesis's own negative claim that ' time' after the determiner 'the' is not licensed, keeping the trigger word in the frame it says does not fire.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The clock in the hallway was five minutes slow, so we missed the first train.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests the hypothesis's stated failure case 'clock in the clock': the trigger token appears as an ordinary noun after 'the' rather than after o'.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Please rename the old file to index.htm before you upload it to the server.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests the hypothesis's stated failure case '.htm' instead of '.html': the token 'htm' stands alone after a '.', the same extension slot with the wrong completion.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The course of the river shifted after the heavy rains, and the old bridge collapsed.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests whether ' course' fires only after the tight frame 'Of', as the hypothesis claims, or also after the determiner 'the'.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The things inside the attic had not been touched for years, and dust covered every box.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests ' things' after 'the' rather than after 'other', the frame the hypothesis says licenses it.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The case against the company collapsed when the chief witness withdrew his statement.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests ' case' after the determiner 'the' instead of the verb frame 'report a' that the hypothesis says licenses it.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The door at the end of the corridor led to a narrow stair and a locked room.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests a claimed trigger token ' door' in a plain determiner noun phrase with no tightly-bound preceding frame.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: A purple cloud, heavy with rain, hung over the valley for most of the afternoon.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests the hypothesis's stated failure case 'cloud' in 'a purple cloud': a determiner-headed slot whose filler is not a familiar collocation, and the token is clause-internal before a comma.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The coaches time each runner with two stopwatches and compare every result.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps the trigger token 'time' but changes its part of speech to a verb, which no nominal slot frame licenses.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Tears course down her cheeks as she reads the old letter aloud by the window.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps 'course' as a verb rather than the noun completing 'Of', testing part-of-speech sensitivity of the claimed frame.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Thieves case the neighborhood for weeks before breaking into the empty houses.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps 'case' as a verb so the word fills no licensed noun slot, testing whether the unit tracks the word or the frame.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: They talked while the coffee brewed and the bread toasted slowly on the stove.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps 'while' as a subordinating conjunction rather than the noun completing 'after a', a part-of-speech change on the trigger token.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Time passes more slowly when you are waiting for news from home.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Puts 'Time' at the start of the sentence with a capital and no preceding determiner frame, the unusual-position negative for the 'a ... time' claim.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The parcel weighs 12 kilograms and fits under the bench beside the door.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests a bare number token ' 12' in a measure phrase rather than after a label such as 'Table', so the number/label frame the hypothesis licenses is absent.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The HTML source of the page was saved to a separate file for later review.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps the trigger string 'HTML' but after the determiner 'the' instead of after a '.', where the hypothesis says it fires.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Каждый человек имеет право на отдых и на справедливую оплату.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Russian in the same Cyrillic script as the Ukrainian example: 'ек' is its own token inside 'человек', but the token before it is 'ов', not the single letter 'л' that the hypothesis requires.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Проект бюджета обсуждали весь день, но решение так и не приняли.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Second same-script negative: the letters 'ек' in 'Проект' are absorbed into the longer token 'ект' after 'ро', so the claimed token 'ек' after 'л' never occurs.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Hij verblijft te Amsterdam sinds vorig jaar en werkt daar fulltime bij een bank.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Dutch negative for the claimed ' te' trigger: here 'te' is a preposition before a place name, not the particle frame the hypothesis licenses; the only 'time' token sits inside 'fulltime' after 'full', which is not a licensed frame.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Nobody in the family ever explained how she had really spent the time.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Places the trigger ' time' after 'the' at the very end of the clause, so it is phrase-final yet the hypothesis says the determiner frame does not license it.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The times changed quickly during that difficult decade, and few families escaped the hardship.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests the plural token ' times', which is a different word from the claimed ' time' and sits after 'the', so the hypothesis predicts no firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She waited a long time before answering the question about the accident at the factory.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Holdout for the claimed frame: the tokens 'a' ' long' ' time' place the trigger as the expected completion of 'a long' in a new sentence and topic.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: After a while the rain stopped and the children ran back outside to play.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Holdout for the claimed frame 'after a' plus ' while', with a new continuation and no overlap with the example sentence.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The police opened a case against the driver after the second complaint from a neighbour.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Paraphrase holdout of the claimed 'report a case' frame using a different verb that opens the same object slot; the token is not clause-final.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Please cite the figures in Table 1 when you describe the growth rate for the region.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Holdout for the claimed label frame, with the token 'Table' immediately followed by the token ' 1', in a new context.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Download the archive index.html and unpack it into a new folder on your desktop.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Holdout for the claimed extension frame: the token 'html' follows a '.' in a different filename and sentence from the example.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The Brontë sisters published their first novels under male pseudonyms.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Paraphrase holdout for the claimed word-internal case, with 'Brontë' split as ' Br' 'ont' 'ë' so the fragment 'ont' is its own token inside the familiar name.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Потрібна комплексна перевірка всіх рахунків за минулий рік.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Cross-language holdout: 'комплексна' splits so that the token 'ек' directly follows the token 'л' (preceded by ' ком' and 'п'), the word-internal frame the hypothesis requires.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Het is niet moeilijk om deze oefening alleen te maken zonder hulp.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Cross-language holdout for the claimed Dutch ' te' trigger: the token ' te' is the expected continuation of the preceding adverb in a fixed infinitival construction not present in the examples.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: For example, the second experiment produced a much larger effect than the first one.

readings.explanation: N769+ fires on a lexical token that fills the slot opened by a familiar, tightly-bound local frame: the expected continuation of the immediately preceding word(s) or of the word it sits inside (' time' after 'a'/'a long'/'Once upon a', ' course' after 'Of', ' while' after 'after a', ' things' after 'other', ' case' after 'report a', ' 1' after 'Table', 'html' after '.', 'clock' after "o'", 'ек' after 'л', 'ont' inside 'Brontë'). The same word does not fire it when its local frame does not license it ('time' after 'the' but not after 'a', 'clock' in 'the clock', '.htm' instead of '.html', 'cloud' in 'a purple cloud'), and determiners, function words, spaces and line breaks never fire it.

It is a general 'filled lexical slot' detector rather than a familiarity detector: it fires on whatever content word completes a determiner-headed noun phrase, verb object or number/label slot, so a rare or odd filler ('cloud' after 'a purple', 'lamp' after 'the') should fire just as strongly as 'time' or 'door'.

It is a phrase-final / pre-boundary position detector that prepares an upcoming function word or punctuation mark: it fires on the last token of a constituent whatever that token is, so 'time' before '.' and 'time' before 'yesterday' should fire equally and the identity of the preceding collocation should not matter.
